candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives all six common inputs and emits one non-policy quotient containing observable obligations without granting implementation provenance authority. The final call consumes that quotient plus all six common inputs, retains full evidence visibility, and emits one policy through a single nonbranching lineage.
candidate_structure.name: Provenance-Quotient Obligation Lift

calls.objective: Extract observable obligations, validity duties, and behavioral tensions from the supplied evidence; neutralize implementation provenance as authority; emit one non-policy obligation quotient without proposing edits, causal repairs, alternatives, or policy logic.

Consume the immediately preceding quotient as construction authority and the common inputs as visible contract evidence, then emit exactly one complete contract-compliant policy whose lineage is obligation-derived rather than anchor-edit-derived.

changed_behavioral_dimensions: phase-shift adaptation posture across regime changes
mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: anchor-relative checkpoint-patch-rollback lineage with terminal delta deletion or compression
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: Observable-contract provenance quotient: construction authority comes from source-neutral obligations while all common inputs remain visible as nonbinding evidence.
rejected_assumptions: The anchor artifact must be the generative substrate for every valid candidate.
Novel behavior must be justified as an ordered stack of reversible anchor-relative deltas.
Terminal causal compression is necessary for structural coherence.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Introduce one observable-contract provenance quotient boundary that removes edit ancestry as construction authority while preserving final-call visibility of every common input.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Obligation-derived construction can jointly reconsider resistance to transient sequences and responsiveness to regime changes without inheriting the anchor's behavioral coupling.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion makes admissible novelty depend on expression as anchor-relative reversible edits, coupling target behaviors to inherited structural premises.

structural_mutation.after: A provenance normalizer first emits a source-neutral observable-obligation quotient; one final constructor consumes that quotient and all common inputs, treating the anchor as visible evidence rather than generative ancestry.
structural_mutation.before: One producer derives the candidate through an anchor-relative transactional repair stack followed by terminal delta compression.
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation changes the authority and lineage carried across the sole inter-call edge from artifact ancestry to observable obligations; it is not terminal-role fission, review, repair rebasing, visibility restriction, or whole-artifact relay.
